summary: Raw reads found nothing to refute. These all hold for Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT: identity (author google; createdAt 2026-03-11; blog 2026-04-02), Apache 2.0 license (the license link redirects to /gemma/apache_2), parameter counts, every config.json architecture value, 262144 context, text+image modalities, the thinking toggle (template default off) and native tool calling (template lines 207-213 and 248). The vLLM v0.33.0 registrations (registry line 427, gemma4 tool and reasoning parsers) hold too. All 14 cited benchmark numbers match their sources exactly: Google card 68.2/77.1/1718/44.1; NVIDIA 57.40/37.22/43.40; Qwen 17.4/13.8/34.2/59.0; KAT 35.80/9.58/20.94. Corrections: (1) Calling the Tau2 setting 'thinking' is inferred; the card does not state it. (2) The template keeps thoughts from the current turn after the last user message whatever preserve_thinking is set to. preserve_thinking (default false) only extends this to older tool-call turns. (3) Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index N/A and release date 2026-04-02 are confirmed; the 71 tok/s and 25.88 s TTFA could not be found in the raw page. Gaps: I did not re-check the QAT GGUF text-only parameter count, the K-to-V line references in vLLM gemma4.py and llama.cpp gemma4.cpp, the llama.cpp, Ollama and memory-arithmetic claims, or the open issue numbers.
